categories.main_business_segments: SBI Global Asset Management operates two main business segments: Asset Management and Financial Services. The Asset Management segment focuses on the creation, offering, and management of public and private investment trusts, as well as providing investment advisory services. The Financial Services segment provides financial information, analysis, consulting, and digital content to both institutional and retail clients, including web-based financial media and tools.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced portfolio management techniques, index and active fund management, and digital platforms for financial data analysis and distribution. It utilizes proprietary systems for fund evaluation, financial data aggregation, and offers digital tools such as 'Wealth Advisor' for investment analysis and simulation. AI and efficient IT systems are increasingly integrated for operational rationalization and product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual investors, financial institutions (such as regional banks and securities firms), and institutional investors both in Japan and overseas. The company also serves financial product distributors, media, and corporate clients seeking financial data, consulting, and investment education services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Japan and the United States, with its main business and customer base in Japan and significant asset management operations in the US through subsidiaries. It also provides services to other regions as part of its global asset allocation strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: SBI Global Asset Management is positioned downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly providing asset management products and financial information services to end customers and financial institutions. It also acts as an intermediary between investment product manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the lineup of low-cost, high-quality investment trusts, developing alternative and crypto-asset funds, and enhancing digital financial information services. The company emphasizes customer-centric product governance, cost leadership, and the integration of AI and digital tools. Sustainability and ESG product development are under consideration, and the company is committed to maintaining independence and objectivity in its financial information services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through management fees from investment trusts and funds, investment advisory fees, and consulting fees. Additional revenue streams include subscription and licensing fees for financial data and digital tools, advertising, and event sponsorships from financial institutions and product providers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese and global asset management firms, as well as financial information providers. SBI Global Asset Management positions itself as a leading, customer-centric, low-cost provider with strong digital capabilities and a robust relationship with the SBI Group, giving it scale and distribution advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue reached approximately 11.57 billion yen, with operating profit of 2.27 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 1.65 billion yen. The company has achieved 13 consecutive years of revenue growth and 16 consecutive years of profit growth (excluding extraordinary items), with assets under management reaching 6.7 trillion yen, reflecting a strong and expanding growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a broad and rapidly expanding lineup of low-cost, high-quality investment products, a strong digital platform for financial information and analysis, and a commitment to objective, customer-focused service. Its integration with the SBI Group enhances its distribution and product development capabilities, while its emphasis on transparency, independence, and innovation supports its reputation as a trusted partner for both investors and financial institutions.
